identity_types.source_event: Exact source-namespaced ID; deduplicate only by stable source identity.
identity_types.request_attempt: One source-issued attempt; retries remain separate attempts.
identity_types.logical_operation: Explicit source grouping or exact authored binding; no timestamp/name/argument inference.
identity_types.nested_envelope: Wrapper and child identities remain distinct and link only through source parent IDs.
identity_types.session_turn_busy_period: Distinct source session, observed turn and runtime busy-period identities.
identity_types.task_artifact_revision_check: Explicit opaque task, immutable artifact revision and check record linked to that revision.
identity_types.agent_delegation: Actual source role plus explicit parent/child and handoff IDs; acknowledgement is not acceptance.
identity_types.producer_epoch: Explicit process/producer epoch scopes counters and reset/restart interpretation.

privacy_rules: No prompts, reasoning, tool arguments/results, commands, error text, paths, memory contents, secrets or raw evidence in metrics.
Opaque project-scoped IDs only; no unsalted raw-content hashes as join keys.
No title, timestamp, text-similarity or latest-prompt joins.
Private evidence drilldown is explicit and separate from aggregate output.
No automatic history backfill, scheduled processing, private evaluations or live configuration changes.

source_compatibility.claim: Repository-pinned baseline; OpenCode CLI/API runtime observed at 2.2.5 on 2026-11-21, plugin pinned at 0.7.0, and Langfuse image/API contract pinned/tested at 4.82.0. Other deployments remain unverified.

evidence.evidence: opencode --version and /api/info runtime response on 2026-11-21; docs/plan/doing/opencode-observability.md documents the event/session limits.
compose.yaml image pins; tests/test_agent_observability.py pins chart types, metrics and observations API semantics.

cohort_contract.eligibility_rule: Admit every policy-eligible request attempt by exact source attempt identity before filtering on result availability; terminal classification requires an explicit producer/task contract.
cohort_contract.closure_rule: Freeze admissions at the declared boundary; close only after each eligible identity reaches an evidenced terminal/deadline or follow-up horizon and the source watermark passes the latest required event plus lateness.
cohort_contract.left_truncation_policy: Exclude and count identities admitted/accepted before cohort entry when required entry time/history is unavailable; snapshots do not establish prior exposure.
cohort_contract.right_censoring_policy: Attempts lacking terminal classification remain pending/unresolved in eligible-attempt coverage; never drop from the denominator or treat as acceptable.
cohort_contract.follow_up_horizon_policy: Require source-declared timeout/grace; no universal timeout.
cohort_contract.late_data_policy: Require event-time watermark and lateness allowance; do not close running attempts or infer missing terminal events from query cutoff.
cohort_contract.watermark_requirement: Record exact source watermark and lateness allowance; absent watermark means open/incomplete population and no completeness claim.
cohort_contract.source_clock_uncertainty_policy: Record measured source-clock uncertainty or explicit unavailable reason. Cross-source order is ambiguous unless event separation exceeds combined uncertainty; never resolve by nearest-time matching.
cohort_contract.uncertainty_policy: Repeated runs within tasks are dependent: cluster at task and preserve run nesting; report independent-cluster count/effect size. Mark small_sample when the method preregistered minimum is unmet; no universal minimum or invented interval.
cohort_contract.multiplicity_policy: Not applicable to this descriptive component; do not infer a hypothesis test or objective threshold.
cohort_contract.quantile_method_policy: Not applicable unless a percentile is emitted.

components.formula: value = agreeing_compared / compared; retain the numeric numerator and denominator; value is unavailable if denominator is zero, incomplete or not independently eligible.
components.formula_source: family definition; component numerator, denominator, population, aggregation, source and missingness are required on each metric instance
components.numerator: independently labeled, non-abstained cases whose labels agree
components.denominator: independently labeled cases compared; abstentions reported separately
components.eligibility: Use only records explicitly eligible under this family definition: Agreement with independent labels, explicit abstention and disagreement categories under versioned rubrics. Require an explicit cohort and stable source identity; if the source predicate or denominator is not evidenced, report unavailable.
components.exclusions: Keep missing, invalid, duplicate, conflicting, ambiguous, unmatched, pending and censored records in separate coverage counts. Exclude only under the declared cohort rule; never treat exclusion or incomplete scans as zero.
components.timestamp_basis: Frozen evaluation/run manifest timestamps and the declared follow-up horizon; matched by fixture/run identity, never by proximity.
components.transform_version_policy: Metric instance must name the exact transform implementation version; if no transform is implemented/versioned, use null and explain in provenance_notes.
components.source_requirement: Independent assessment or controlled experiment is required; no production outcome claim.

cohort_contract.eligibility_rule: Use only records explicitly eligible under this family definition: Agreement with independent labels, explicit abstention and disagreement categories under versioned rubrics. cohort_contract.closure_rule: Use frozen case/run manifest and exact immutable identities; cohort is complete only after every scheduled case has a terminal disposition or declared missing-run status.
cohort_contract.left_truncation_policy: Fixture/run entry is explicit; no historical production backfill.
cohort_contract.right_censoring_policy: Aborted, missing or unfinished runs remain unresolved/censored; do not silently drop or classify without rubric evidence.

cohort_contract.late_data_policy: Freeze manifest/run cutoff before scoring; late, aborted or missing artifacts receive a new explicit disposition, never silent removal.
cohort_contract.watermark_requirement: Record exact source watermark and lateness allowance; absent watermark means open/incomplete population and no completeness claim.
cohort_contract.source_clock_uncertainty_policy: Record measured source-clock uncertainty or explicit unavailable reason. Cross-source order is ambiguous unless event separation exceeds combined uncertainty; never resolve by nearest-time matching.
cohort_contract.uncertainty_policy: Repeated runs within tasks are dependent: cluster at task and preserve run nesting; report independent-cluster count/effect size. Mark small_sample when the method preregistered minimum is unmet; no universal minimum or invented interval.
cohort_contract.multiplicity_policy: Predeclare primary outcomes, comparison family and multiplicity correction before inspection; absent a correction, label comparisons exploratory and make no confirmatory significance claim.
cohort_contract.quantile_method_policy: Not applicable unless a percentile is emitted.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Terminal events carry session identity, may cover coalesced drains, and do not carry prompt/turn/task identity.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Keep the busy period separate; never bind to the latest prompt or infer task completion.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Event payload persistence/replay is not guaranteed; captured events may be missed, dropped, or interrupted.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Show capture coverage unavailable without independent receipt/admission/emission/acknowledgement/ingestion counts; do not enable broad persistence to fill gaps.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Native metrics do not provide a general parent/child join or high-cardinality trace/session grouping.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Use bounded structural report joins only where explicit parent IDs are present; preserve unmatched, ambiguous and window-boundary counts.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Project-wide tool observations may come from integrations other than OpenCode.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Label native tool charts project-wide; call tools harness-linked only when an explicit supported ancestry link exists.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: A wrapper call does not prove which nested operations executed or provide their request/attempt identities.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Keep envelope and children separate; nested coverage unavailable until independent eligible-request counters and source parent IDs exist.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Title, compaction and other auxiliary generation purposes are not reliably classified by current observations.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Report purpose unknown unless explicitly supplied by the producer; do not infer from timing/name.

unsupported_correlations.source: Langfuse v2 totalCost and OpenCode generation cost
unsupported_correlations.limitation: Current cost values do not establish an independent split between provider-reported and locally inferred cost.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Keep one recorded cost measure with provider/currency caveats; mark the separate inferred-cost component explicitly unavailable.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Current start and terminal events have distinct source event IDs and no verified stable compaction-operation ID for repeated operations in one session.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Count starts and terminal states separately; compaction duration is explicitly unavailable.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Current trace IDs are deterministic domain-separated SHA-256 digests of source event/session/request IDs, but are not project-keyed.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Treat exported identities as legacy compatibility only; new v1.1 producers must use project-scoped opaque identifiers or a private keyed mapping.

cohort_and_statistics_policy.cohort_closure: Lifecycle cohorts are defined at admission/acceptance before result filtering, stop accepting entries at a declared boundary, and close only after terminal/follow-up horizons and source watermarks pass. A query window or snapshot is not lifecycle closure.
cohort_and_statistics_policy.left_truncation: Exclude and count identities whose entry predates observable cohort or lacks required entry history; do not infer prior exposure from snapshots.
cohort_and_statistics_policy.right_censoring: Running/open intervals and immature follow-up remain pending/censored with counts and last observation. Completed-only percentiles describe completers only; survival estimators need a named method and assumptions.
cohort_and_statistics_policy.late_data: Use source event-time watermarks plus declared lateness. Late arrivals produce a new versioned result; never silently rewrite prior reports or automatically backfill history.
cohort_and_statistics_policy.source_clock: Record source clock identity and numeric uncertainty or reason. Cross-source ordering is ambiguous unless separation exceeds combined uncertainty; prefer same-process monotonic durations.
cohort_and_statistics_policy.sampling: Report design and inclusion probabilities. Known-probability samples may use an explicitly named weighted estimator; unknown/convenience/hand-selected samples are descriptive and cannot be extrapolated.
cohort_and_statistics_policy.pooling: Show strata separately first. Pooled raw values are labeled unweighted descriptive summaries; population estimates use only declared inclusion-probability weights and a versioned estimator.
cohort_and_statistics_policy.uncertainty: For repeated observations cluster at task and preserve run nesting. Report effect size, independent cluster count, method and interval; small_sample uses a preregistered method minimum, no_target means no objective, and precision/thresholds are never invented.
cohort_and_statistics_policy.multiplicity: Predeclare primary outcomes, comparison family and adjustment method; otherwise multiple comparisons are exploratory, not confirmatory.

family_specific.C3: Separate eligible receipt, queue admission/drop, unique emission, acknowledgement and independently confirmed ingestion. Stage ratios require compatible populations/windows and unchanged epochs; absent upstream accounting, reset or watermark makes dependent ratios unavailable.
family_specific.T3: Classification coverage is classified terminal attempts / all eligible admitted attempts in the closed cohort. Pending/unresolved remain visible and are never treated as acceptable.
family_specific.T4: Unexpected technical rate uses only classified technical outcomes; unknown/pending/unresolved, canceled and policy-blocked are separately counted beside T3 coverage.
family_specific.F3: Percentiles use valid completed admission-to-terminal intervals only; show completion-conditioned interpretation, sample size, censored/left-truncated counts and exact quantile method.
family_specific.M3: Fully labeled zero-relevant-memory queries are separately scored for explicit abstention; precision/recall with zero relevant denominator are unavailable, not zero.
family_specific.Q6: Only accepted tasks with a matured, source-watermarked declared follow-up enter reopen denominator; immature/censored follow-up is separate.
family_specific.X4: Full-cohort resource yield is unavailable if any eligible run lacks complete compatible resource evidence; partial subtotals cannot be ranked as full-cohort cost/yield.

cohort_contract_schema.title: AI Observatory component cohort/statistical contract v1.2

contract_examples.rule: Mature only when accepted_at + horizon + lateness <= as_of and watermark covers the endpoint; missing entry is unknown, not a non-reopen.
Never include censored runs in completed-only percentiles or interpret them as the full-cohort time-to-terminal distribution.
Every ratio requires compatible populations/windows and unchanged epochs; absent/reset counters or missing watermark makes dependent ratios null with a reason.

Use inverse-inclusion weights only for known positive probabilities; unknown/hand-selected samples are descriptive only and cannot be extrapolated. If inclusion probabilities are unknown or the evidence is hand-selected, report only the sample description and prohibit population inference.
A zero denominator remains unavailable, not a zero rate.
Duration bounds are end-start plus/minus the sum of endpoint clock bounds. A cross-source ordering is ambiguous when the event gap is not greater than combined uncertainty.
